name: UI Animation
goalName: Create a UI where, on the press of a button, an overlay is animated in and out
goal: For the industry project I have to create a UI. When the companion (red box model) is clicked, the owl should give the player some options. This has to be done by showing an overlay, and some options to choose.

approach.text:
<<source Technologies, U. (2021, December 10). Unity - Manual: Using Animation Events. Unity Documentation. Retrieved December 14, 2021, from https://docs.unity3d.com/Manual/script-AnimationWindowEvent.html>>
<<source DocFX. (2020, October 6). Designing UI for Multiple Resolutions | Unity UI | 1.0.0. Unity. Retrieved December 14, 2021, from https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.ugui@1.0/manual/HOWTO-UIMultiResolution.html>>

normalLearnings: I can add custom resolutions to a game.
I can create animation controllers using multiple animations.
result: As seen in the evidence, the dialogue options smoothly fade in and out. When clicking on anything except one of the options, the dialogue is closed. I had to redirect the event from the animation because the UIHome class was a component higher in the hierarchy, which can be seen here:<<image 3.png>>The result can be seen in the following video:<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/DWG6IXCDik4>>
validation: I validated my work through testing and reviews by both peers and a teacher.
contribution: Now the dialogue options are finished for now, the actions themselves need to be implemented. This directly contributes to the final product.
